episodes.title: Sabu: The Rise and Reflections of LulzSec's Leader
episodes.description: Hector Monsegur (Sabu) in depth — from hacktivism to white hat. His most comprehensive interview. Essential listening for anyone who wants to understand LulzSec from the inside.

episodes.title: From Hacktivist to White Hat — Sabu Interview
episodes.description: Monsegur on founding LulzSec, the FBI turn, and his pen testing career. The story of how the most wanted hacker in America became one of its most effective security researchers.

episodes.title: What It's Like to Fight LulzSec
episodes.description: The law enforcement side of the 50 Days — told by the people who chased LulzSec across the internet in real time. Malicious Life at its best.

episodes.title: Edward Snowden — Joe Rogan Experience #1368
episodes.description: Nearly 3 hours. NSA mass surveillance, PRISM, life in exile, and why he still believes it was worth it. The most-watched Snowden interview ever. 10M+ views.

episodes.title: Julian Assange and the Dark Secrets of War — DW Documentary 4K
episodes.description: Full documentary post-release. WikiLeaks, Collateral Murder, the Belmarsh years, and what his freedom actually means for press freedom globally.

episodes.title: The Internet's Own Boy — Aaron Swartz Documentary
episodes.description: The definitive film about Aaron Swartz. Free on YouTube. If you watch one thing on this list, make it this. 26 years old. Facing 35 years. Gone too soon.

episodes.title: DEF CON Conference Talks — Full Archive
episodes.description: Free recordings of the world's most important hacker conference going back decades. Elite research, zero-day disclosures, and the culture that produced LulzSec.

episodes.title: The Cyber Mentor — Ethical Hacking Full Course
episodes.description: Heath Adams. The best free ethical hacking course on YouTube. Beginner to advanced. OSCP prep, web app testing, career advice. 1M+ subscribers.

episodes.title: A Passion for Change — Topiary's Full Interview
episodes.description: The rare 3-hour interview with Jake Davis (Topiary) conducted just after LulzSec disbanded. Most of it was never published until now. Essential reading.

episodes.title: Julian Assange: Inside the WikiLeaks Saga
episodes.description: The definitive video biography. From anonymous hacker to global figure to Belmarsh prisoner to free man. The most comprehensive single piece on Assange.
